headlines.title: ASML Stock What Changed After Nvidia CEO Return
headlines.summary: ASML Holding reported recent share repurchases under its ongoing buyback program and saw renewed interest after Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, which lifted sentiment toward AI chip suppliers that rely on its EUV tools. The news cycle highlighted how ASML’s monopoly in extreme ultraviolet lithography ties its order outlook and capacity planning directly to customers’ AI and memory buildout decisions.

headlines.title: ASML (ENXTAM:ASML) Stock May Trade At A Premium Following Its 107% Run
headlines.summary: ASML Holding has seen its stock more than double over the past three years, while headlines around artificial intelligence hardware keep pulling the share price around. With that backdrop, the real issue for anyone looking at ASML today is whether the current valuation is supported by the cash the business can generate over time. The share price has returned 107.3% over three years, which puts a lot of weight on the question of how strong and durable ASML's future cash flows can be.

headlines.title: Why ASML Stock Popped Today
headlines.summary: The AI sector soared as Jensen Huang returned to Nvidia.

headlines.title: ASML Stock’s Sell-Off Looks Excessive Against Its Growth Outlook
headlines.summary: ASML Holding’s (ASML) stock sell-off looks excessive against its growth outlook, in my view. The lithography equipment manufacturer reported record quarterly sales of €11.7 billion in Q3 2026. During the earnings call, CEO Christophe Fouquet said planned supply for 2027 and 2028 “will not fully meet the demand of our customers.” That is a striking message during a semiconductor sell-off.

description: ASML Holding N.V. provides lithography solutions for the development, production, marketing, sales, upgrading, and servicing of advanced semiconductor equipment systems. The company offers lithography, metrology, and inspection systems. It also provides extreme ultraviolet lithography systems; and deep ultraviolet lithography systems comprising immersion and dry lithography systems solutions to manufacture various range of semiconductor nodes and technologies. In addition, the company offers metrology and inspection systems, including YieldStar optical metrology systems, a diffraction-based wafer metrology platform to assess the quality of patterns on the wafers; and HMI electron beam solutions to locate and analyze individual chip defects. Further, it provides computational lithography solutions, and lithography systems and control software solutions; and refurbishes and upgrades lithography systems, as well as offers customer support and related services. Additionally, the company offers hardware, software, and services to chipmakers to produce the patterns of integrated circuits. It operates in Japan, South Korea, Singapore, Taiwan, China, rest of Asia, the Netherlands, rest of Europe, the Middle East, Africa, and the United States. The company was formerly known as ASM Lithography Holding N.V. and changed its name to ASML Holding N.V. in 2001. ASML Holding N.V. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Veldhoven, the Netherlands.
